passages.section_path: Chapter 1. Introduction > 1.6. Exceptions, Traps, and Interrupts > Contained Trap
passages.text:
### **Contained Trap**

The trap is visible to, and handled by, software running inside the execution environment. For

example, in an EEI providing both supervisor and user mode on harts, an ECALL by a user-mode hart will generally result in a transfer of control to a supervisor-mode handler running on the same hart. Similarly, in the same environment, when a hart is interrupted, an interrupt handler will be run in supervisor mode on the hart.
